deploy-bot: CANARY NOTICE: error_rate(5m)=5.4% (baseline 0.7%), deploy=release/v4.0.0-canary
Laura P.: noticed. which slice?
Jin W.: slice 5 (model-heavy background jobs). stack shows repeated grpc UNAVAILABLE and retry storms.
Marco D.: any schema/model mismatch? 4.0 swapped tokenizer shards but we tested locally.
Laura P.: recommendation: prefer staged pin (canary -> rollback) before fleet-wide pin. we have runbook for partial pins.
Jin W.: plan: 1) apply human lock on auto-rollouts 2) reduce canary traffic to 25% 3) demote canary back to v3.9.5 4) run 30m observation.
Release-Bot: auto-rollout lock required for demote. Use ``/deploy lock auto-rollout --by <user>``
Marco D.: I'll do the demote. executing: ``/deploy lock auto-rollout --by Marco D.`` then ``/deploy demote-image --pool canary --to v3.9.5 --reason "canary grpc retries"``
deploy-bot: DEMOTE STARTED: job_id=dem-20260710-02, initiated_by=Marco D., target=canary
Laura P.: drafting comms: short internal post in #status, note: no dedicated customers affected. ping support to watch for escalations.
Ops-Bot: NOTE: dedicated-pools unaffected. Posting incident ticket template.
deploy-bot: DEMOTE COMPLETE: job_id=dem-20260710-02, status=success, new_active_image=v3.9.5
Jin W.: starting 30m observation window. suppressing noisy retry alerts for 35m.
Marco D.: also toggled a temporary circuit-breaker on the grpc client to avoid retry amplification.
Laura P.: follow-ups: create rollback-postmortem ticket, include telemetry slice, add a regression test for tokenizer shard fallback.
Release-Bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: incident/2026-07-10-canary-grpc-retries, assignees=[Marco D., Laura P., Jin W.], severity=high
Jin W.: if stable after 30m, we'll re-open canary with reduced traffic and the circuit-breaker in place. full fleet pin only if recurrence in canary.
Laura P.: agreed. updating release board and holding v4.0.0 change-window until root cause fixed. will notify PMs. :white_check_mark:
